name: Protect files
description: Keeps the agent out of files a person should edit: .env and other secrets, keys and certificates, lockfiles, and the .git directory. Edits, writes and patches to a protected path are refused with the reason, and so is a shell line that would change one (a redirection, rm, mv, sed, git and the like); reading it is fine.

config.label: Protected paths
config.description: Globs: * within a folder, ** across folders, ? one character. A pattern without a slash matches the file name anywhere.
